title: TEKMOVELA GatePolicy v1alpha1
description: A versioned, immutable policy that locks the release gate chain G0..G5: per-gate required evidence kinds, dependency order, waiver eligibility, and acceptance thresholds. Gate decisions are reproducible from locked policy and locked inputs.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state of the policy. Published policies are immutable; only published policies transition to superseded or revoked.

digest.description: Canonical digest of this exact policy version, bound by publish. Never set by callers.

gates.description: Policy rules for every release gate in the chain.

G0_requirement.description: G0 requirement gate: every acceptance criterion and constraint must be testable and covered by a published VerificationContract.

G1_harness.description: G1 harness gate: the harness version must be published, deterministic, isolated, and free of critical coverage debt.

G2_test.description: G2 test gate: no critical scenario failures and statistical confidence above the acceptance bound.

G3_authority.description: G3 authority gate: no authority or delegation violations; not waiver eligible.

G4_runtime_readiness.description: G4 runtime readiness gate: runtime readiness signals must be complete before release.

G5_evidence.description: G5 evidence gate: evidence complete and verifiable with no unresolved counterevidence.

required_evidence_kinds.description: Evidence kinds the gate must observe before it can pass.

dependencies.description: Gate keys that must have passed before this gate may evaluate.

waiver_eligible.description: Whether a waiver can convert a block into a waived decision for this gate.

thresholds.description: Optional acceptance thresholds for the gate.

requirement_coverage.description: Minimum requirement coverage fraction required by G0.

min_confidence.description: Minimum statistical confidence required by G2.

runtime_ready.description: Whether G4 requires runtime readiness signals complete.
